query:
SELECT 
  branchId,
  COUNT(*) as total_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND expiryDate <= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as expiry_risk_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND expiryDate <= NOW() THEN costPrice * quantity ELSE 0 END) as expiry_risk_loss,
  SUM(CASE WHEN totalSalesQuantity = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead_stock_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN totalSalesQuantity = 0 THEN costPrice * quantity ELSE 0 END) as dead_stock_value
FROM inventory
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-05' AND branchId IN (20, 300012)
GROUP BY branchId;
